value.rationale: This gives the previously missing exact equality-case classification for the natural complete golden-mean target family: the odd optimum set has exactly m+2 elements, and every optimizer automatically obeys the same local constraint as its targets. An exponential family of targets collapses to a linear single-marker test at sharp letter content. These natural global equality cases and the exact count are not a mere restatement of the known optimal length.
